items.title: Starting condition recorded
items.description: Record the visible starting condition and any existing damage before work begins.

items.title: Defined safety controls reviewed
items.description: Confirm the job's recorded controls and hold points have been reviewed; this is not a certification.

items.title: Work performed recorded
items.description: Compare actual work with the approved scope and record deviations.

items.title: Unresolved defects reviewed
items.description: Record every unresolved defect and follow-up action.

items.title: Defined acceptance criteria evaluated
items.description: Evaluate only criteria explicitly recorded in the job and retain their sources.
